//: app.config.ts, config/, and plugins/ are Node build-time files (like babel/metro config, which expo excludes); they run under Node and are validated by `expo config`, not the react-native bundler typecheck scope. vitest.config.ts also runs under Node but is included: it checks cleanly here, and no other program typechecks its test list or the options it passes the shared helper. scripts/ holds Node scripts (run with `node`) that are included for the same reason; each pulls in the Node types with a `/// <reference types="node" />`.
